system.name: TVM
system.configuration: separate build-llvm, Release, LLVM 21.1.8, native macOS arm64

initial_boundary_surface_note: S0 uses ordinary row-major OIHW; TensorIR match_buffer describes the target call ABI, not a new payload format. ReplaceConv is an authored Relax selection policy, make_external_conv declares the external target call, and export_library links the supplied object. S0 has no preceding stage, so these are not revisited boundaries. Classification corrected during the pre-freeze S0 audit; functional artifacts and oracle results are unchanged.
boundary_vector_note: S0 establishes the initial surface; no domain is revisited until S1 changes the frozen stage.

boundary_evidence.policy: build.py ReplaceConv visits the imported Relax conv2d call and rewrites it to call_tir; this is a selection policy even though S0 selects both shapes.
boundary_evidence.target: build.py make_external_conv defines the TensorIR function and declares the evolution_conv external call.
boundary_evidence.artifact: build.py export_library links the supplied kernel object as an addon to the native TVM artifact.

timing_policy: Functional S0 preflight only. No smoke-test compiler or inference timing is publication evidence.
